extendedContent.badgeText: ⚡ Ultra-Low Latency | 100% Undetectable | Local & Cloud AI

featurePillars.title: Hardware-Routed Audio Stealth
featurePillars.description: Bypasses Windows Media Foundation capture hooks. Audio routes directly to your private earpiece so no call participants ever hear it.

featurePillars.title: Screen-Aware Multimodal OCR
featurePillars.description: Reads coding problems, diagrams, and formulas directly off your active screen in real-time.

featurePillars.title: Résumé & Coding Copilot
featurePillars.description: Tailors generated answers to your exact background, past projects, and solves live coding challenges with optimal time complexity.

workflowSteps.title: Launch & Enter Key
workflowSteps.description: Open Voro on your Windows PC. It silently sits in your system tray.

workflowSteps.title: Load Context
workflowSteps.description: Paste your target job description or résumé so answers are tailored to your real experience.

workflowSteps.title: Join Meeting
workflowSteps.description: Open Zoom, Teams, or HackerRank. Voro listens and projects instant answers to your private HUD.

faqs.question: Will Zoom, Teams, or Google Meet detect Voro?
faqs.answer: No. Voro utilizes hardware-level overlay layering that is completely invisible to screen-sharing capture software.

faqs.question: Can interviewers hear Voro voice output?
faqs.answer: No. Voro routes audio exclusively to your selected headphone output, bypassing Windows recording hooks.

faqs.question: Can I use my own Gemini or OpenAI API keys?
faqs.answer: Yes. Voro supports Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) for zero token markups, as well as 100% offline local models (Ollama).
